visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a black sweatshirt sits on a bed, looking intensely at his smartphone. Bright white speed-line graphics overlay the scene. Meat graphics appear as floating thumbnails. (2) The man looks directly at the camera, pointing his finger upward in an emphatic gesture. (3) The scene shifts outdoors. The same man and an older man are seen wearing long-haired wigs, trench coats, and fishnet stockings. They walk toward the camera in a humorous, exaggerated fashion. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the older man's legs, which are clad in black fishnet stockings and sandals. A spotlight graphic emphasizes the leg. (5) The two men walk through the glass door of a brightly lit restaurant. (6) A female customer inside the restaurant turns around with a shocked and amused expression, looking at the cross-dressing men. (7) At the service counter, the men interact with a male staff member wearing a tan apron and mask. (8) The scene transitions to the dining table. The men have removed their coats and are sitting in front of a grill filled with various cuts of raw meat. (9) A close-up shows a large piece of steak being grilled on a wire mesh over hot coals. (10) A chef in a red uniform and blue gloves uses a large knife to slice a thick slab of raw ribeye steak on a cutting board. (11) The men are seen eating and gesturing with their hands, expressing satisfaction. (12) The camera pans across a buffet section showing fresh vegetables, salads, and prepared side dishes. (13) The men toast with glasses of beer, followed by a series of graphic slides showing restaurant logos and promotional text over shots of grilled meat.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The younger main character wears a black long-sleeved shirt and later a blonde wig. The older main character wears a black t-shirt, a red and black jacket, and later a long brown wig and fishnet stockings.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A simple bedroom with a blue patterned duvet, followed by an urban sidewalk in front of a modern commercial building, and finally the interior of a Japanese-style BBQ restaurant with wooden partitions and industrial exhausts.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy electronic BGM and rapid-fire male Mandarin speech. A loud 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual graphics. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound occurs as thumbnails appear. The younger male voice speaks with high pitch variability and enthusiasm. (3) A sudden cartoonish 'slip' sound effect triggers as the scene shifts to the men outdoors. Laughter tracks are faintly audible in the background. (4) The older man's voice enters with a comical, deep-toned delivery. A 'sparkle' SFX punctuates the close-up of his legs. (5) As they enter the restaurant, the BGM remains steady, but the vocal tone shifts to an interactive dialogue with the staff. (6) 'Crunch' and 'sizzling' sound effects are mixed prominently during the eating sequence. (7) The BGM swells for the final promotion, with the speaker increasing his speech rate to deliver the campaign details, concluding with a celebratory impact sound.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Comedic Demonstration -> In-store Experience -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic promotional advertisement for the Wangpin Group's BBQ brands (Oh My! Yakiniku, Meat Square, and Gingu). It uses a humorous 'cross-dressing' challenge where the protagonists wear fishnet stockings to secure a significant discount (10% off or a chance at 90% off), thereby creating a viral-style social media challenge to attract young customers to the restaurants.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features direct brand logos, mentions specific promotional dates, and showcases the dining experience at named restaurant brands within the Wangpin Group.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-arousal audio and fast-paced editing characteristic of TikTok/Reels advertising. The use of older generations participating in Gen-Z trends adds a 'cringe-humor' appeal intended to increase engagement.
